title: Lot Split Application: Completeness Checklist
notice: Invented for the citycenter demo. The Town of Sample Creek does not exist.

items.label: Applicant phone or email
items.hint: One way for staff to reach the applicant.

items.label: Applicant mailing address
items.hint: Where the written completeness letter will be sent.

items.label: Parcel number
items.hint: The county parcel number of the existing parcel, written like SC-123-456.

items.label: Site address or location
items.hint: Street address, or the nearest road and a description of the location.

items.label: Road frontage of each proposed lot
items.hint: Feet of frontage along the public road for each lot.

items.label: Road access for each lot
items.hint: Direct frontage, or a recorded access easement at least 20 feet wide.

items.label: Water and sewer for each lot
items.hint: Town water and sewer, or the intended well and septic arrangement.

items.label: Existing buildings and their distance to each proposed lot line
items.hint: Say 'no buildings' if the parcel is vacant.

items.label: Sketch or site plan
items.hint: Parcel boundary with dimensions, proposed lot line with dimensions, existing buildings, the adjoining road and a north arrow.

items.label: Legal description of the existing parcel
items.hint: As written on the recorded deed.

items.label: Owner authorization
items.hint: The applicant is the owner of record, or the owner's written authorization is attached.

items.label: Flood hazard statement
items.hint: Whether any part of the parcel is in a mapped flood hazard area.

items.label: Review fee acknowledgement
items.hint: The $250 lot split review fee is due at filing.
